title: MultiHeadLatentAttention init dispatched to Attention branch — wrong layers initialized
root_cause: InitMethod.init_attention dispatched on isinstance(m, Attention) before isinstance hasattr(m, 'wq_a'). Because MultiHeadLatentAttention inherits from Attention and exposes w_q, the MLA branch was never reached; the projections wq_a, wkv_a, wkv_b were never initialized while only w_q was, leaving the rest at the dtype-empty allocation values.
invariant: Every nn.Linear weight in attention sub-modules must be initialized exactly once via the appropriate init_attention branch before training starts.
diff_summary: Reorder init_attention to test hasattr(m, 'wq_a') first so MultiHeadLatentAttention is dispatched to its specific init branch.
silent_check: Buggy init does not raise — torch.empty produced finite (uninitialized memory) values for wq_a/wkv_a/wkv_b; the model trains but starts from non-deterministic, very-out-of-distribution weights for the latent KV projections.
